name: Executive Summary Dashboard
description: High-level business metrics and KPIs for executive team

cards.name: Monthly Recurring Revenue
cards.description: Current MRR from all active customers

native.query:
SELECT 
  COALESCE(SUM(mrr), 0) as total_mrr,
  COUNT(*) as active_customers
FROM customer_health 
WHERE status = 'active'

cards.name: Customer Acquisition Cost
cards.description: Average cost to acquire a new customer

native.query:
SELECT COALESCE(ROUND(AVG(acquisition_cost)::numeric, 0), 0) as avg_cac
FROM crm_data 
WHERE status = 'closed_won' 
  AND created_at >= [[{{time_period}}]]

SELECT COALESCE(ROUND(AVG(lifetime_value)::numeric, 0), 0) as avg_ltv
FROM customer_health 
WHERE status = 'active'

cards.name: LTV:CAC Ratio
cards.description: Lifetime value to customer acquisition cost ratio

native.query:
SELECT 
  ROUND(
    (SELECT AVG(lifetime_value) FROM customer_health WHERE status = 'active') /
    NULLIF((SELECT AVG(acquisition_cost) FROM crm_data WHERE status = 'closed_won' AND created_at >= [[{{time_period}}]]), 0)
  ::numeric, 1) as ltv_cac_ratio

cards.name: Net Promoter Score
cards.description: Current NPS based on recent surveys

native.query:
SELECT 
  ROUND(
    (
      COUNT(CASE WHEN nps_score >= 9 THEN 1 END) -
      COUNT(CASE WHEN nps_score <= 6 THEN 1 END)
    ) * 100.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0)
  ::numeric, 0) as nps
FROM customer_feedback 
WHERE created_at >= [[{{time_period}}]]
  AND nps_score IS NOT NULL

cards.name: Monthly Churn Rate
cards.description: Percentage of customers that churned this month

native.query:
SELECT 
  ROUND(
    COUNT(CASE WHEN status = 'churned' AND updated_at >= DATE_TRUNC('month', NOW()) THEN 1 END) * 100.0 /
    NULLIF(COUNT(CASE WHEN updated_at >= DATE_TRUNC('month', NOW()) THEN 1 END), 0)
  ::numeric, 2) as churn_rate
FROM customer_health

SELECT 
    DATE_TRUNC('month', closed_date) as month,
    SUM(deal_value) as revenue,
    COUNT(*) as deals_closed,
    LAG(SUM(deal_value)) OVER (ORDER BY DATE_TRUNC('month', closed_date)) as prev_revenue,
    ROUND(
      ((SUM(deal_value) - LAG(SUM(deal_value)) OVER (ORDER BY DATE_TRUNC('month', closed_date))) * 100.0 /
       NULLIF(LAG(SUM(deal_value)) OVER (ORDER BY DATE_TRUNC('month', closed_date)), 0))
    ::numeric, 1) as growth_rate
FROM crm_data 
WHERE status = 'closed_won' 
  AND closed_date >= [[{{time_period}}]]
GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('month', closed_date)
ORDER BY month

cards.name: Key Business Metrics
cards.description: Overview of critical business metrics with period comparison

native.query:
WITH current_metrics AS (
  SELECT 
    COUNT(CASE WHEN ch.status = 'active' THEN 1 END) as total_customers,
    COALESCE(SUM(ch.mrr), 0) as total_mrr,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN cd.status = 'closed_won' AND cd.created_at >= [[{{time_period}}]] THEN 1 END) as new_customers,
    COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN cd.status = 'closed_won' AND cd.created_at >= [[{{time_period}}]] THEN cd.deal_value END), 0) as new_revenue
  FROM customer_health ch
  FULL OUTER JOIN crm_data cd ON ch.customer_id = cd.customer_id
),
previous_metrics AS (
  SELECT 
    COUNT(CASE WHEN cd.status = 'closed_won' AND cd.created_at >= [[{{comparison_period}}]] AND cd.created_at < [[{{time_period}}]] THEN 1 END) as prev_new_customers,
    COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN cd.status = 'closed_won' AND cd.created_at >= [[{{comparison_period}}]] AND cd.created_at < [[{{time_period}}]] THEN cd.deal_value END), 0) as prev_new_revenue
  FROM crm_data cd
)
SELECT 
  'Total Customers' as metric,
  cm.total_customers as current_value,
  NULL as previous_value,
  NULL as change_percent
FROM current_metrics cm
UNION ALL
SELECT 
  'Monthly Recurring Revenue',
  cm.total_mrr,
  NULL,
  NULL
FROM current_metrics cm
UNION ALL
SELECT 
  'New Customers',
  cm.new_customers,
  pm.prev_new_customers,
  CASE WHEN pm.prev_new_customers > 0 THEN 
    ROUND(((cm.new_customers - pm.prev_new_customers) * 100.0 / pm.prev_new_customers)::numeric, 1)
  ELSE NULL END
FROM current_metrics cm, previous_metrics pm
UNION ALL
SELECT 
  'New Revenue',
  cm.new_revenue,
  pm.prev_new_revenue,
  CASE WHEN pm.prev_new_revenue > 0 THEN 
    ROUND(((cm.new_revenue - pm.prev_new_revenue) * 100.0 / pm.prev_new_revenue)::numeric, 1)
  ELSE NULL END
FROM current_metrics cm, previous_metrics pm

SELECT 
  'Leads Generated' as stage,
  COUNT(*) as count,
  100.0 as conversion_rate
FROM crm_data 
WHERE created_at >= [[{{time_period}}]]
UNION ALL
SELECT 
  'Qualified Leads',
  COUNT(*),
  ROUND((COUNT(*) * 100.0 / NULLIF((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM crm_data WHERE created_at >= [[{{time_period}}]]), 0))::numeric, 1)
FROM crm_data 
WHERE lead_score >= 70 AND created_at >= [[{{time_period}}]]
UNION ALL
SELECT 
  'Opportunities',
  COUNT(*),
  ROUND((COUNT(*) * 100.0 / NULLIF((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM crm_data WHERE created_at >= [[{{time_period}}]]), 0))::numeric, 1)
FROM crm_data 
WHERE pipeline_stage IS NOT NULL AND created_at >= [[{{time_period}}]]
UNION ALL
SELECT 
  'Customers',
  COUNT(*),
  ROUND((COUNT(*) * 100.0 / NULLIF((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM crm_data WHERE created_at >= [[{{time_period}}]]), 0))::numeric, 1)
FROM crm_data 
WHERE status = 'closed_won' AND created_at >= [[{{time_period}}]]

cards.name: AI Agent ROI
cards.description: Return on investment from AI automation

native.query:
SELECT 
    agent_name,
    ROUND(cost_savings::numeric, 0) as cost_savings,
    ROUND(efficiency_gain::numeric, 1) as efficiency_gain,
    ROUND(roi_percentage::numeric, 1) as roi_percentage,
    total_interactions
FROM agent_performance 
WHERE calculated_at >= [[{{time_period}}]]
ORDER BY roi_percentage DESC

SELECT 
  'Sales' as department,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM crm_data WHERE status = 'closed_won' AND created_at >= [[{{time_period}}]]) as deals_closed,
  (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(deal_value), 0) FROM crm_data WHERE status = 'closed_won' AND created_at >= [[{{time_period}}]]) as revenue_generated,
  (SELECT ROUND(AVG(lead_score)::numeric, 1) FROM crm_data WHERE created_at >= [[{{time_period}}]]) as avg_lead_score
UNION ALL
SELECT 
  'Marketing',
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM crm_data WHERE created_at >= [[{{time_period}}]]),
  NULL,
  (SELECT COUNT(CASE WHEN lead_score >= 70 THEN 1 END) * 100.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) FROM crm_data WHERE created_at >= [[{{time_period}}]])
UNION ALL
SELECT 
  'Customer Success',
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customer_health WHERE status = 'active'),
  (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(mrr), 0) FROM customer_health WHERE status = 'active'),
  (SELECT ROUND(AVG(health_score)::numeric, 1) FROM customer_health WHERE status = 'active')

cards.name: Revenue Forecast
cards.description: Revenue forecast based on current pipeline

native.query:
SELECT 
  DATE_TRUNC('month', expected_close_date) as forecast_month,
  SUM(deal_value) as pipeline_value,
  ROUND(SUM(deal_value * win_probability / 100.0)::numeric, 0) as weighted_forecast,
  COUNT(*) as deal_count
FROM crm_data 
WHERE status NOT IN ('closed_won', 'closed_lost')
  AND expected_close_date >= DATE_TRUNC('month', NOW())
  AND expected_close_date <= DATE_TRUNC('month', NOW()) + INTERVAL '6 months'
GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('month', expected_close_date)
ORDER BY forecast_month
